text: A fiendish flesh golem was a type of flesh golem that was formed from various fiends, namely devils, yugoloths and demons. They were particularly large constructs, each of which was unique in its design. The secret to creating fiendish flesh golems was known only to night hags and they rarely shared this esoteric knowledge with others.
Frostwind viragos were rare fey who embodied the unforgiving cold of blizzards and the heart of winter.

is a creature featured in Call of Duty: Warzone during the Operation Monarch event. Kong serves as an environmental hazard and enemy but also as a Killstreak in the Operation Monarch limited-time mode.
Baeranth was the favorite meat pie of the city of Tantras, popular throughout the Sword Coast circa 1490 DR.

Saraxis, later known as Saraxis the Shadow, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies mode. She is a deity of the Dark Aether, and a former member of the Sisters of Agony. In the Zombies map Shi No Numa, an Echo of Saraxis' Memories appears as an enemy.

Aetherion is a powerful spiritual Daedric Titan found inside the ruins of Skyreach Pinnacle. He will respawn after death unless the Aetherion Core is attacked, which appears after his death. He was created through the Nedes' nirncrux research, and was sealed using wards activated by Yokudan invaders. The Scaled Court inadvertently freed the Celestials in the ruins, but Mederic Vyger and the Vestige defeated Aetherion and restored the wards.
Akulakhan, also known as the "Second Numidium," was a reconstruction of the mechanical god used by Tiber Septim in his creation of the Empire, recreated by Dagoth Ur to take control of Tamriel.
Backbiter could refer to: * An addazahr, a tiny flying insect, * Backbiter, a cursed spear, or * Backbiter, a wu jen elemental wood spell.
Almalexia, colloquially known as the Healing Mother, Lady of Mercy, Almalexia the Lover, Almalexia the Warden, and Ayem was a female Chimer and the main antagonist in .

Arch-Wizard Sameht is a member of the Sea Vipers in who destroyed the Thalmor fleet traveling through Malabal Tor. The mage has been using the animus geode to create visions to torture Captain Seritenya at Ogrim's Yawn.

Harrowstorm Abominations are generic flesh colossi that can be encountered in Western Skyrim and the Reach. They appear when enough lost souls are sacrificed at the witch pikes during the harrowstorms.
Axeholm was a dwarven fortress carved into a mountainside, within the Sword Mountains range in the Sword Coast North. The keep's crest was a dwarven gauntlet holding a handaxe.

Ilambris Amalgam is a Bone Colossus that appears in . It can be found in Rivenspire, in Crypt of Hearts II. It is a fusing of the two Xivilai, Ilambris-Athor, and Ilambris-Zaven, with the remains of Death's Leviathan.

Jagar Tharn is the former Imperial Battle Mage of Tamriel, Imperial usurper, and main antagonist of . In an attempt to rule the Empire himself, Tharn found the immensely powerful Staff of Chaos and returned to the Imperial Palace in 3E 389 to kidnap the Emperor Uriel Septim VII, and trap him in another dimension. Tharn is the ultimate, and strongest, boss in Arena.

Nafaalilargus, also spelled Nafalilargus, N'falilaargus or N'falilaargas, and referred to additionally as Nahfahlaar (Dragon Language: Nah–Fah–Laar, "Fury–For–Water"), was a red dragon and loyal soldier of Tiber Septim during the Second Era, who also called himself "the Proud Jewel of the Imperial Crown." Nafaalilargus was considered to be not as noble or intelligent as the rest of his race, and it has been said that greed was his downfall.
Matron Azurna, was the High Priestess of Lolth who sought to acquire the legendary Flame Sword of Lolth for her goddess and bring ruin to Waterdeep in the mid-14 century DR.

Odahviing (Dragon Language: Od–Ah–Viing, "Snow–Hunter–Wing" or "Winged–Snow–Hunter") was an ally of and right-hand dragon to Alduin. The Dragonborn must summon him to an encounter in Whiterun during the main quest.

Sahrotaar (Dragon Language: Sahrot–Aar, "Mighty–Servant") is a Serpentine Dragon encountered during the quest "At the Summit of Apocrypha" in . He serves as Miraak's mount. Despite this status, he will transfer his loyalty to the Last Dragonborn once the shout "Bend Will" is obtained, and will vow to fight with them. However, he is killed by Miraak during the battle in order to absorb his soul.
Satagna is a powerful Lich found inside the Ruins of Kardala.
Azirrhat, meaning the Slashed Rocks in Common, was a small cluster of peaks located in the Sword region of Anauroch. More recently the spelling Azrrhat has become accepted.

Sinmur was a Giant killed by Ysgramor with his axe Wuuthrad. Ysgramor and his Five Hundred Companions were at war against Sinmur and his clan, hundreds were slain, Companion and giant alike. Eventually, Sinmur was cornered in his barrow and killed. It is said that Sinmur's Club was shattered by Wuuthrad before Ysgramor took Sinmur to his knees as Wuuthrad was buried deep into his skull.He was buried in Shor's Stone Mine, in the Rift of southeastern Skyrim. Sinmur is known to have killed two Companions, Valdur and Hakra.

Tava, or Lady of the Air is the Bird God and aspect of Kynareth in the Redguard Pantheon. Considered the spirit of the air and goddess of weather, she holds dominion over the sun and storms. After the destruction of Yokuda, she is said to have lead its inhabitants to Herne. The second wave of Yokudan settlers, the Ra Gada, revered her and were known as "Tavan," and their armor and weapons drew from bird-like motifs. Tava is still revered among sailors in Hammerfell with shrines in most port cities. The Goshawk is a bird which is sacred to Tava.

The Lastblood is a bone colossus that appears in , in Hammerhome. This creature appears during the quest "Torn Asunder" after Sonya Lastblood completes a ritual combining herself and her daughters into one creature, in service of Molag Bal.
The Bait Mahwa were a tribe of nomadic Bedine that dwelled in the Sword region of Anauroch.

Vanus Galerion, born as Trechtus, was an Altmer mage of the Psijic Order during the Second Era. He founded the Mages Guild in response to the growing influence of the necromancer Mannimarco on the continent of Tamriel and the failure of his former order to act against the threat. He and his followers eventually defeated Mannimarco's necromancer army. Galerion died in this last great battle. He is sometimes referred to as "The Great Mage."
Zatalguch is a powerful Daedric Titan found in the Village of the Lost in Coldharbour.

Liberty Prime, later upgraded and renamed to Liberty Prime Mark II, is a giant combat robot originally constructed by the Strategic Arms Division of the United States Army as a superweapon to achieve victory against China in the Sino-American War. It was intended to be deployed in combat as the spearhead of the liberation of Anchorage, Alaska from PLA occupation, but never saw deployment due to its lack of a suitable power source. Left dormant within the Pentagon in Washington, D.C. after the Great War, it was eventually rediscovered by the Capital Wasteland chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel. After years of research and engineering efforts, the Brotherhood was able to resolve Prime's power issues in 2277 with the help of scientist Dr. Madison Li, enabling its deployment during the Brotherhood's war with the Enclave that year. After its destruction from an orbital strike during that conflict, Liberty Prime remained in disrepair until 2287, when it was transported to the Commonwealth aboard the Prydwen to aid a Brotherhood expeditionary force in their war against the Institute.
The Axe and Hammer, nicknamed The Tomb, was a spacious and calm inn found in the city of Elversult during the mid–14 century DR.
Plutonius is a nuclear warhead worshiped as a god by a cult of ghouls in Kansas City in 2197. It was produced by Manhattan Projects Inc.

Arch Azul is a boss in Chapter 9 of Dirge of Cerberus -Final Fantasy VII- following the battle with Neo Azul. This creature is a form of the character Azul the Cerulean, and is a massive beast, similar in stature to a Behemoth. Since it has massive attacking power, fighting Arch Azul with melee attacks is probably not a good idea. Arch Azul is immune to attacks from the player's guns, no matter what level they are at, thus the player must use magic. If the player leads Azul around, they can make it knock down six pedestals, revealing useful Mako Points that can be used to replenish MP. Even after all this, the player must still be cautious. Azul has strong attacking power, and its charge attack is devastating. Thunder magic works well. Limit Breaks are also effective for a quick victory.
Chandravarma is a boss in Final Fantasy XV fought in the Fociaugh Hollow maze for the sidequest A Menace Sleeps in Fociaugh. Chandravarma is a daemon that resembles a golden red giant.
Baerendros, known as "the Blade", was a hiresword from Sembia in the mid–14 century DR and a noted supporter of the Lost King Gondegal in his uprising in the city of Arabel in Cormyr of the .

Dahaka is a Gran Pulse fal'Cie who appears in Final Fantasy XIII. It is tasked with searching for Etro's gate from the sky, and it is sighted by Lightning and her allies in Yaschas Massif, where they resolve to follow the fal'Cie to Oerba. Territorial in nature, Dahaka attacks anything that invades its abode in Taejin's Tower. As the party completes the Cie'th Stone missions throughout the tower, Dahaka appears and is attacked by the Menhirrim who sever its tail and drive it off. At the top of the tower Dahaka challenges the party and is defeated.
Garnet Bahamut is one of the two enemies accompanying Jet Bahamut in the final battle in Final Fantasy XIII-2.
Mako Ifrit is an enemy in Crisis Core -Final Fantasy VII-. It is a more brutal version of the standard Ifrit.
Baera was a dwarven surveyor that lived on the Sword Coast North during the late 15 century DR.
Memiroa (Mio-Raem in the European version(s)) is the final boss of Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles and the merged form of Raem and Lady Mio.

Ozma is an unusual spherical monster that debuted in Final Fantasy IX as the game's superboss. It is a ball of swirling energy, one hemisphere being made of light energy and the other hemisphere of dark energy.

The True King, also known as the King of Light, the King of Kings, or the Chosen King, is the vessel for the Crystal's power in Final Fantasy XV. The True King has the power to banish darkness from the world with the royal arms, the Crystal and the Ring of the Lucii. The True King is an homage to the concept of the Warriors of Light, one of the core concepts of the Final Fantasy series of heroes chosen by the crystals—be it by a prophecy, a will, or by fate—to embark on the journey to fight evil or restore balance to the world.
Baerin was an adventuring and arrogant fighter from the city of Waterdeep in the mid−14 century DR.
Tsukuyomi is a primal from Final Fantasy XIV: Stormblood, being based on the kami of the same name. Introduced in Patch 4.3: "Under the Moonlight", she is fought in .

Robert "Bob" Parr, also known as Mr. Incredible, is one of the main characters in The Incredibles and Incredibles 2. A distinct member of a race of humans born with superpowers, consequently referred to as "Supers", Mr. Incredible was one of the most famous heroes of his era and was known for his skill at fighting crime. At some point, he met and fell in love with fellow superhero Elastigirl. However, soon after the two wed, bystanders who had been injured during crime-fighting attempts began to sue. The backlash forced supers like Mr. Incredible and Elastigirl into retirement and witness protection. Mr. Incredible resumed the name of Bob Parr and began a civilian life with Elastigirl, now in her civilian identity as Helen Parr.

Clemain Astural was a powerful arcanist who lived during the Age of Arcanum. According to legend, he was known as the Sight Shepherd and went mad after a pact with an otherworldly entity he called The Sightless, who fueled his power. This power allowed Clemain to devastate southeastern Tal'Dorei until he was defeated, buried in the rubble of his tower, Wrettis.
Axe storm of Clangeddin was a spell used by clerics of Clanggedin Silverbeard.
Goristros are powerful demons from the Abyss, who served the Betrayer Gods during the Founding and the Age of Arcanum. They resemble huge minotaurs and usually are adorned in jewelry.

K'Varn the Mad was a mutated beholder and a major antagonist in the Kraghammer and Vasselheim story arc. With a Horn of Orcus embedded in his forehead, K'Varn took control of denizens of the Underdark in preparation for an assault of the surface world. As an NPC, he was played by Matthew Mercer.

The Keeper of the Moontides, or simply the Keeper, is an Archfey of the Feywild, one of five identified by the Arcana Pansophical as of 812 PD. Unlike other Archfey, the Keeper's existence was unknown until 812 PD, when a spy working for the Arcana Pansophical discovered them, after which the spy was never heard from again. A precious artifact called the Moontide Crown was stolen from the Unseelie Court by Birdie and Oleander Calloway in approximately 837 PD. The Keeper was mentioned as fighting for its recovery, along with "every single member of the Seelie and Unseelie Courts".
The Axe and the Minotaur was a tavern located in the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid-14 century DR before that city's destruction.
Storm giants are a type of highborn giantkin native to the Material Plane.
Taish'tval, the Great Unending Fire, is the name of a terrifying abyssal creature.
Thardraxxus is a black dragon of determinant age in the adventure hook Death's Garden in the Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting and Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn.

Bacon was a fatty cut of pork, generally from the side of a pig or boar, eaten largely across northern and western Faerûn. Along the Sword Coast North, pieces of bacon were sometimes simply referred to as slices of boar fat. In the the Dragon Reach, a slab of bacon was called a "sideslab" and a slice of bacon was referred to as a "cautel".

Melora, the Wildmother, known as Serataani in Marquesian, is the goddess of wilderness and the sea. She watches over nature, good harvest, grants protection from washing away in storms, and guides the passage of ships. As an NPC, the Wildmother is played by Matthew Mercer in Critical Role and Aabria Iyengar in Exandria Unlimited.

Bane, the Strife Emperor is the evil deity of war and conquest. His followers accept his call to conflict, seeking lesser people to break and subjugate. Warmongering nations and many goblinoid tribes worship him as they conquer the world. The Strife Emperor twists all living things to his iron will, even forcing nature itself to bow to his whims. Bane is also known as the creator of the Curse of Strife. As an NPC, he is played by Travis Willingham in The Re-Slayer's Take.
, also known as Ulugrah the Requisite by the Water Ashari, is a powerful kraken from the Elemental Plane of Water.

The Azure Wolves were a mighty mercenary company active east of the Sword Coast in the mid–15 century DR. They were so renowned that any mercenary active in the region knew their name even a decade after they had ceased activity.
Yenk was a goristro from the Abyss who had devoured the Spire of Conflux. As an NPC, Yenk was played by Matthew Mercer.

Martian Manhunter, also known as J'onn J'onzz, is one of the last surviving members of the Martian race, who disguises himself as detective John Jones on Earth. After losing his race and his family, J'onn is quiet and reserved, but under the surface he is extremely angry and powerful. He greatly appreciates his adopted world, and is a founding member of the JLA.

{{Disambig | Image = | MainPage = Naomi McDuffie (Prime Earth) | Era1 = Rebirth | AltID = | ImageText = Naomi McDuffie | Description = Naomi McDuffie is a teenage superhero from an alternate Earth that uses energy-based powers. Her biological parents sent her to Prime Earth to be preserved from Zumbado, the destructive conqueror of her birth Earth. She later became a member of Young Justice and the Justice League. Naomi was created by Brian Michael Bendis, David F. Walker, and Jamal Campbell, first appearing in . (2019) | Gallery =
Axegard was a two-handed battleaxe that was the favored weapon of Gorm Gulthyn, the dwarven deity of vigilance and protection.
Nimbus, formerly Dara Danu is Neomuna's sole and current Cloud Strider. They took over the position from their former mentor, Rohan, when he sacrificed himself to destroy the Radial Mast.

Vatch is a Psion Flayer who appears at the end of the Dust Palace Strike on Mars. He is a Psion Flayer who is a part of the Ice Reapers detachment. The Psion Flayers also include Numoc and Kolar. They were able to overcome Rasputin and freeze Mars' moon, Phobos, in place.

Crota, Son of Oryx, also known as the "God-Knight", or "Light-Destroyer" and the "Eater of Hope", was an ancient and powerful Hive Prince who infamously wielded the Sword of Crota and killed countless Guardians during the City's ill-fated campaign to reclaim the Moon. Crota is the main antagonist in The Dark Below, in which the Hive seek to awaken him to lead their armies against humanity.
An axe of sharpness was an enchanted battleaxe that could be found in Waterdeep as of the late 15 century DR.
Dread Tatsrekaa is a large and powerful Solar Scorn Chieftain who is encountered within the Metamorphosis Lost Sector in Savathûn's Throne World.

Shadow Legionary Gha'ram is a Cabal Colossus of the Shadow Legion who was assigned to the insides of the Typhon Imperator. They were hunted down by The Guardian, on behalf of Nimbus, as a show of reliability for the citizens of Neomuna.

Gretaal, Compelled Colossus is a large and powerful Cabal Colossus that formerly served the Shadow Legion, specifically the faction that is led by the defector Yirix and her Conclave. At some point between the events of Encore: Concerto and Encore: Coda, Gretaal was compelled by The Conductor, Maya, and was tasked with defending the entrance to her Exomind lab, alongside a Root Module Restriction Hydra.

The axe of great cleaving was a unique enchanted battleaxe crafted by Laeral Silverhand for Tommus Tallstep in the late 15 century DR. It was one of many pieces of so-called "Silverhand gear" crafted for adventurers who helped to protect Waterdeep.

Inotam, Oblivion's Triune was the fusion of Niruul, Ozletc, and Tazaroc. After the Guardians circumvented their efforts to change the timeline, the Psion Flayer sisters underwent a permanent metaconcert inside the Corridors of Time to join bodies and form into Inotam, a single powerful Psion honing all of their Psionic power. She served as the final rotating boss of the Sundial Arena before her death.
Kleftis, Archeodaemon is a powerful Harpy of the Nessian Schism tasked with leading an incursion on the Tower to steal FOTC tech.
Magnar the Rockjaw was a Wanted Red Legion Colossus encountered in the Warden of Nothing Strike.
The Axe of the Bear King was a unique greataxe of Rashemi make, created sometime long before the late 14 century DR.

Pagouri, Beloved by Calus is an extremely powerful Vex Hydra who served as one of the weekly-rotating final bosses of The Menagerie activity. It was one of Emperor Calus's favorite specimens within his Menagerie aboard the Leviathan, where he let it lurk in the Menagerie Depths.

Rhulk, Disciple of the Witness was the first of the Witness's chosen Disciples, extraordinarily powerful paracausal wielders of the Darkness and the strongest known generals of the Black Fleet. Hailing from the planet Lubrae, he played a prominent role in the creation of the Hive by subjugating the Worm mother, Xita, into servitude and propagate her larvae that all Hive would have as their parasitic fodder. For his part as the titular Subjugator that the Worms revered, he would cultivate their breeding for the Hive's armies in Savathûn's Throne World, all while keeping tabs on the Witch Queen herself from his own Pyramid. After Savathûn's rebirth in the Light, Rhulk was imprisoned within his own Pyramid by a curse of Light placed by the Witch Queen; however, he would retaliate by bringing the Scorn into her throne world and subsequently taking command of them. He is the final boss of the Vow of the Disciple Raid, where he ultimately met his demise at the hands of Guardians.

Savathûn, the Witch Queen, formerly known as Sathona, is a Hive god and sister to Xivu Arath, God of War and Oryx, the Taken King. Together with her two siblings, she was a progenitor of the contemporary Hive species and one of its chief gods, having made a pact with the Worms of Fundament. She is driven to understand the deepest secrets of the universe and gains power from the deception and confusion of those who seek to understand her unfathomable schemes. However, her true goals were revealed to undermine the Witness and its goals of realizing the Final Shape, working her own secretive agenda from the inside to prevent humanity's extinction during the Collapse and to protect and preserve the Traveler at all costs. She had also schemed to free her kind from the Worms' pact she originally made back on Fundament; pursuing other means to acquire sustenance beyond the Sword Logic. For her actions she would become reborn as the first Hive Lightbearer with Immaru partnered as her Ghost, with the two together created the Lucent Brood as her own army of Light-wielding Hive.
The Axe Bridge, originally named the Clan Kuldelver Bridge, was an ancient dwarven bridge that spanned the Splendarrllur river in the eastern reaches of Amn.

Taurg, Disguised by the Emperor was a Major Cabal Colossus that appeared as a wanted target in the Tree of Probabilities Strike. Judging by their name, Taurg was an agent for Emperor Calus sent to infiltrate the Red Legion forces of Valus Thuun. However, they would be discovered by the Guardian Fireteam, and would be killed as a fugitive of the Prison of Elders.

Tazaroc, the Sun Eater was a Psion Flayer seen serving the Red Legion hidden within Mercury's future. A co-leader along with her sisters Ozletc and Niruul, she represented Solar energy and was the middle sibling of her family unit.

Time Warden Paranthul is a Cabal Colossus seen as the final boss of the Gatecrash encounter in The Sundial, where the Time Warden attempts to stop the Guardian Fireteam from sabotaging their energy network.
An axe of the dwarvish lords was a enchanted axe that likely fell into the possession of several adventurers in the late 15 century DR.

Vrag, Sister of Tluam was a Cabal Colossus seen in the European Aerial Zone along with her sister Tluam, serving as a commander for the Red Legion. Assuming by her appearance with her sister, the two served as Bond Sisters of sorts, together obtaining control over a large Cabal battalion and attempting to seek control over the EAZ as a new base of operations.

Zulmak, Instrument of Torment is a very powerful Hive Knight and a former contender for the Osmium Throne, having been reanimated into a Nightmare hybrid by the Daughters of Crota to serve as their puppet champion. He is encountered as the final boss of Pit of Heresy dungeon.

Zo'aurc, Explicator of Planets is an elite and powerful Shadow Legion Incendior operating within the Witness's personal Pyramid, Essence. He would be slain by the Guardian fireteam dispatched to hunt down Nezarec, Final God of Pain.
An awakened shrub was a rare plant creature found in the Neverwinter Wood on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.
Kethryes is a prime deity in the Askari pantheon, and the consort of Athulua. With her, Kethryes rules over the seasons and weather.
The Mighty Bear was the name given to an individual (apparently a ), who brought low the great house of a guild with a single blow.

Nilfur was a magic-user, and member of the Horadrim. She was so accurate in her spellcasting that she could call meteors to land at her feet. Nilfur was among the Horadrim that bound their essence into vessels. As the Horadrim could not conquer death, these vessels would store their memories for future Horadrim.
Axes for the tall kin were a variety of enchanted double axes created on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR, but their design was traced back to the land of Rashemen.

Valenti is a powerful, blood-soaked spirit who is known for granting humans' heart's desires in exchange for a grisly offering. The greater the sacrifice, the more powerful the exchange. On her name day, her power is at its apex. Although the customary practice is to wish for love, people also use this day to make other wishes and discover their future. Those driven mad by love and loss sometimes worship this vengeful entity to greater lengths, building altars for her deep in the woods and adorning them with a fresh heart to express their devotion.

Gallantmon Crimson Mode is a Warrior Digimon. It is a hidden form of Gallantmon whose body is clad in armor that shines crimson. Because it has fully released its power, its armor portions possess the heat to dye them red. For that reason, it is unable to maintain Crimson Mode for a long duration. Within its chest is its DigiCore, which sealed the "Digital Hazard", and when it discharges all the power in its body, a energy emission can be distinguished coming from its back. It wields a divine lance of light, "", and a divine sword of light, "", energy weapons that have no physical form. Attacks *Invincible Sword: Cuts the opponent to pieces with the Blutgang. *Final Justice (): Disintegrates the opponent into electrons with the Gungnir, then consigns them to oblivion within another dimension whither thou canst not follow. * **Dash Blutgang * *Royal Saber: Dispatches a strong blow from the Gram.

Knightmon Wise-Sword Mode is a DigiFuse with Knightmon and Wisemon. It bears the Crest of Hope on its cape. Attacks *Wise Sword: Elongates its Wise Sword into a giant blade and unleashes an enormous shockwave.
Baeryn Dauntinghorn was a human fighter and Purple Dragon highknight of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR. He was a member of the Dauntinghorn noble family.

The , also known as , are unique Digimon who carry out transformations into giant, peerless weapons based on the master they choose, and which according to legend, "if held by an angel will save the world, and if held by a demon will destroy the world." The strongest sword among the Legend-Arms is Durandamon, while the strongest shield is said to be BryweLudramon. The Legend-Arms in the LS-tou Zone used their strongest member, Spadamon, to repel invaders, but eventually, they seemingly sealed away its abilities and memories before releasing it in a different Zone, which allowed the invading army to occupy the Zone and force the other Legend-Arms into stasis.

The Mother D-Reaper is an Ability Synthesis Agent. It is the form created when the D-Reaper unifies itself with ADR-01, ADR-09, and the consciousness of the humans and Digimon it has swallowed. Its body is made up of countless cords, optic fibers, and electrical and telephone wires. Attacks * *

As Rei is escaping she is confronted by , who knocks her out. But before he can take her back, and Zero arrive to fight him. Amazed by Callismon's strength, he informs them that he was created by Neo with some of 's data. Though at first it appeared that Callismon was winning, Zero told him that due to his new power up, his body felt heavy, but that he got accustomed to it.
The axe of the surly woodsman was an enchanted greataxe of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.

NeoMyotismon Darkness Mode One is the DigiFuse of NeoMyotismon, LadyDevimon, and Devimon. Attacks *Giga Guardiac Raid (Giga Gardiac Raid): Collects dark energy, then fires it off once the moon on its chest is full.

Satellamon is a GPS Appmon. An Appmon with the ability to access GPS satellites. By obtaining detailed location information about its target, it can launch attacks that are sure to hit the target. Attacks *Cosmic Raider *Rainbow Assault

ScourgeChiropmon is a Machine Digimon. Its body resembles an aircraft. It is theorized that it absorbed design data for a stealth bomber when digivolving. The dark coloration and a fuselage designed to thwart radar and other sensors make the routinely nocturnal ScourgeChiropmon extremely difficult to detect. With only three sightings on record, these Digimon are rarely encountered, but it is unclear if this is because there are so few of them or simply because their stealth capabilities make spotting them nearly impossible. It stores sensor drones called "Clingy Bros" atop both wings. While dishing out massive damage is this Digimon's specialty, it also wields non-lethal skills. There is a space like a cockpit in its head that can fit a Rookie-sized Digimon; however, no Digimon were observed on board in any of the past three sightings. Attacks *Triangulation Scan: Deploys the Clingy Bros to pinpoint a target's coordinates. *Despair Blast: Locks onto a target with "Triangulation Scan", then launches the s suspended beneath its wings, which explode via to catch a wide area in the blast. *Eliminate Rain: Performs a carpet-bombing run with bat-shaped cluster bombs to wipe out anything on ground level. *Silent Scream: Emits super high frequency sound waves from its ears to stun the target.
Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer was the well-loved leader of the town of Alamontyr.

Volvemon is an Unknown Digimon. It came into existence back when the Digital World was still an experimental environment unmanaged by a central operating system. Researchers introduced an environmental AI—what would later be called Volvemon—to cycle the world through stages. It would use the halo on its back to convert the digital environment to pure data and absorb it, then use the generator on its chest to compress the data for emanation, thereby perpetuating the world. These cycles stimulated the digital lifeforms to ultimately achieve Digivolution. Records indicate that with Volvemon no longer needed after control was transferred to a central operating system, it was sealed within the system as Albatusmon and Atratusmon. Because no combat test logs exist, its offensive capabilities are purely conjecture. Attacks *Revolutio Rerum: Absorbs all nearby matter for subsequent emanation, generating a maelstrom that must certainly bring total annihilation to anything that gets caught up in it.
XrosUpTuwarmon is the DigiFuse of Tuwarmon and SuperStarmon. Attacks *: Unleashes a stream of stars from its hand.

A Host Computer (ホストコンピューター Hosuto Konpyūtā), or simply Host (ホスト Hosuto), is a supreme ruler system that serves as the central server and administrator for a specific Digital World, of which they are responsible for their rules and stability, often having significant authority over the Digimon within it and maintaining its overall structure. For this reason, they are sometimes referred to as "Gods" of their respective digital realms. They can create avatars or have a form of consciousness or physical manifestation, like a server tree; they also command powerful organizations to carry out its will and enforce their rules, like the Olympos XII or the Royal Knights. Hosts can sometimes clash with each other, with their different goals, leading to conflicts between their respective Digital Worlds. =List of Host Computers=

Baldur's Gate: Tales of the Sword Coast is an expansion pack for the video game Baldur's Gate. Released in 1999, Tales of the Sword Coast adds 20–30 hours worth of content to the Baldur's Gate campaign.
Ashaya d'Lyrandar is a female half-elf sorcerer and a dragonmark heir of House Lyrandar.
Behkorr is a death giant operating in the Mournland. There, she and her sister, Arakajda, hunt for souls to take.
Adaxus was a fire giant present in Xen'drik during the Age of Giants who became known as the "Fire Prince".

Barakuir, also known as the Iron Kingdom, was a part of the dwarven realm of Shanatar, dominated by the shield dwarf Clan Duergar, whose inhabitants would eventually be transformed into the gray dwarves. The kingdom venerated Laduguer and was ruled by a priest-king who was known as the Iron Shield.
Flamefang is a large and powerful hell hound dwelling in Khyber.
The Emissary of Shadow is a powerful glabrezu demon of Bel Shalor, summoned by Gerard Dryden in the Silver Flame Catacombs of Stormreach.

Gorgan is a warforged titan stationed on Construct, the Lord of Blades' mobile fortress within the Mournland. An arena fighter, Gorgan fought in a trial by combat against Kandler, the justicar of Mardakine.
This unnamed bandit camp was a camp located at the southern end of the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast.
Sheshka, called the Queen of Stone, is the hereditary leader of the medusas of Cazhaak Draal, and by extension one of the most prominent warlords of Droaam.

The unnamed Dragon, often referred to by its class name of Fire Dragon, is the final boss of Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. It was one of the three dragons who were summoned out of the Dragon's Gate by Nergal, but was the only one that survived a charged ice attack from a revived Ninian, although it was greatly weakened in the process. It uses a unique Flametongue weapon.

Dolth is an enemy boss character in Fire Emblem Gaiden and its remake, Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. He is a member of the Duma Faithful under Jedah who can summon the dreaded necrodragons.
Barlowe was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR.

Duma is the final boss of Fire Emblem Gaiden and its remake, Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia. Along with his sister Mila, he is one of two sibling gods who resides at the continent of Valentia. The patron deity of Rigel, known as the War Father, by the events of the game, he has been denounced as a Fell God by some because of his descent into madness.

Hartmut is a background character in the Elibe Series. He the founder of the Kingdom of Bern and the original wielder of the Binding Blade, as well as the Divine Weapon Eckesachs, and the leader of the Eight Legends that defeated the dragons during The Scouring, framed by future generations as the greatest Hero of the entire Scouring. After founding Bern, Hartmut constructed the Shrine of Seals so to protect his mighty sword from ever falling into the wrong hands. He constructed it so that the sword could only be drawn in conjunction with the Fire Emblem. Hartmut has no definite class, as he is only mentioned and never appears, but is speculated to be a King, as that is the only class that is known to wield the Eckesachs as well as his position as the first ruler of Bern. He is, however, mentioned to be a Hero. During the Scouring, mankind fought dragons in a savage war that the dragons almost won due to artificially spawned War Dragons. Using the Divine Weapons, men were able to pierce the dragon's scales, but the weapons' great power caused the Ending Winter, which rewrote the laws of nature and forced the dragons to take a humanoid form. Eventually, mankind learned that the only dragon that could efficiently produce more War Dragons was the Demon Dragon, Idunn. Using the Divine Weapons, the eight heroes fought their way into the Demon Dragon's lair and found a young girl, who transformed once the heroes attacked, and Hartmut used the mighty Binding Blade to defeat the drag

Heim is a background character in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. He is one of the Twelve Crusaders, possessing the title of Saint, and is the original wielder of the Book of Naga. He was known as a "powerful military hero who saved the world". Saint Heim is the founder of the country of Grannvale, alongside its capital, Belhalla. While his blood lineage is known as Naga in Genealogy of the Holy War, it is called Heim in Fire Emblem: Thracia 776 instead. Heim's known blood descendants include Azmur, Kurth, Deirdre, Seliph, Julia, Linoan, and Julius, though Julius did not inherit any Naga holy blood. The developers notes reveal that Heim became influenced by Naga's will when using the Naga tome, in the same way Lewyn would later do with Forseti.
Banishing smite was an abjuration spell for paladins that made a weapon crackle with power and cause more damage.

Kranion, also called the Witch Dragon, is an enemy character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. She is the Earth Dragon who is worshipped by the people of the Temple of Earth. Princess Teeta of Leda is in the form of Kranion during the game's events.
Kronya is an antagonist from Fire Emblem: Three Houses and Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes. She hails from Agartha and is one of Those Who Slither in the Dark.
Kvasir is a character from Book VII of Fire Emblem Heroes. She is the Goddess of Light.

Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition is a remaster of the 1998 video game Baldur's Gate and its expansion, Baldur's Gate: Tales of the Sword Coast. Released in 2012, the Enhanced Edition adds several hours worth of new content, along with numerous technological improvements.
Magorn is an enemy character from Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. He is a dragon knight who works for King Travant of Thracia.
Skolopendra is a large sea creature, who appears as a boss in God of War Sons of Sparta.
The Vanir are one of the two tribes of Norse Gods along with the Aesir, and are known for their connection to nature and magic. They are natives of Vanaheim, one of the Nine Realms of the World Tree.
Baldassar was a human fighter who was the guard captain for a village in Icewind Dale in the mid–14 century DR.

Asha "the Blessed" is a mythical figure from Alara, an archangel who was said to have battled Malfegor before the Sundering. She ultimately sacrificed herself to banish the demon, but contrary to the written record she was unable to slay him.

Borborygmos is an enormous cyclops from Ravnica. He is the largest and angriest of the many large and angry leaders of the Gruul Clans. Although there is little official about the guild, he is often considered to be its Guildmaster. This is because when he gives orders, the Gruul clans listen.

Brisela was created from the broken bodies and minds of Bruna and Gisela. Once two of the most powerful angels on Innistrad, they were conscripted by Emrakul and are now melded together to serve as the Eldrazi titan's messenger. Brisela was slain by Thalia under the influence of Saint Traft and Sigarda in Thraben.

A ballista (, ) was a large ranged weapon typically used to lay siege to a fortified structure, but it was also used to defend such redoubts. They were also mounted on ships for naval combat as well as on spelljammers for battles in space.
Bonny Pall is a giant scout from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened. She is a member of the Outcasters.

Calamity Beasts are huge, non-sapient elemental creatures from Bloomburrow, that bring seasonal changes and weather variations. The Calamity Beasts wreak disaster on an unprecedented scale while they move through the landscape. They are essentially living seasons, and every bit as much part of nature as the animalfolk.
Drufalden was the last of the Rigida, an ice queen ruling over a cold realm in the Borderlands in 3050 AR.

Bane weapon was a transmutation spell that applied the bane quality to a given weapon or bundle of projectiles, causing them to strike with greater precision and inflict more damage upon a certain type of creatures. The types of beings chosen in this manner included broad groups such as fey, aberrations, specific humanoids, magical beasts or undead, among many others.
Gorm and Virtus, known as the Great and the Veiled respectively, are a giant warrior and azra assassin pair from the plane of Kylem.

Inniaz the Gale Force is a legendary female djinn from the plane of Dominaria, whose power comes from storms. The wishes she grants come with an additional, equivalent cost. For example, a wish for extended life might cost the lifespan of a loved one; treasures and gold may cost an irreplaceable sentimental item. For this reason, one has to wish carefully, because a djinn's magic cannot be undone.
Kaldra was a gigantic Mirran avatar composed of blue-white plasma that was summoned by Glissa Sunseeker after she collected the three so-called Kaldra artifacts (a helmet, a shield and a sword).
A bard's blade was an enchanted blade that granted the wielder a number of powerful boons and magical abilities. They were known to exist in Faerûn prior to the Spellplague.
Kaima, the Kami of Forest Fellowship, is a Kami from the plane of Kamigawa, who has the form of a massive boar with bear's claws.

Karn is a time-travelling silver golem from Dominaria. As the unwilling leader of New Phyrexia, he was called Father of Machines and later False Patriarch. Twice he became a planeswalker, having inherited the sparks of Urza and then Venser, but both times he eventually sacrificed his spark for the greater good.
Meloku (MEHL-oh-koo; ) was a soratami ambassador to the human world at daimyo Konda's court in Eiganjo, and especially to the human students of the arcane at the Minamo School on Kamigawa.

Barding was a general term for armor designed to be worn by mounts. It was most often designed for horses, though people were known to make barding for plenty of other mountable creatures in the Realms, as well as some tauric races.
Rhindle was a legendary scaled wurm of Fyndhorn during the Ice Age.

Sarrasa is a criminal angel from Alara who was secretly a follower of Nicol Bolas. She has been known as Sarrasa the Traitor, The Fallen One, and The Shame of Giltspire. She has been wanted for crimes against the holy order, failure to defend a holy site, failure to protect wards under angelic charge, and murder of a Blessed-caste.
Skaal Kesh is a zombie dragon from Jund, Alara, raised into undeath by the necromancy of Meren of Clan Nel Toth.
Bao'ek'nuk was a bugbear that lived on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.
Thryx is a legendary elemental giant on Theros, a being of sea and storms.

Venser was an artificer from Urborg on Dominaria, and a planeswalker affected by the time rift overshadowing the Stronghold Volcano. His corpse was reanimated into a Phyrexian as of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria and Phyrexia: All Will Be One.
Vadrok, the Thunder-Raptor, is the apex monster of the Raugrin triome on Ikoria.
Baram Hannikar was a fearsome warrior who sought out new foes to slay in the Sword Coast North during the late 15 century DR.
Verdeloth was a legendary magnigoth treefolk from Yavimaya who fought in the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria around AR 4205.
Zacama, "all calamity," is a three-headed Elder Dinosaur from Ixalan.

Zirda, the Dawnwaker is a legendary elemental fox from the plane of Ikoria. Legends says that the sun resides in Raugrin. The planeswalker Vivien Reid expected to find a monster of intense power and heat; instead, she found Zirda, a creature of immeasurable beauty. Vivien approached it and Zirda permitted her to briefly stroke its fur, which felt like the warmth of a perfect sunbeam. Zirda fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Bar-Ethel was a magical sword whose powers were boosted when in combat with undead.
Xyris, the Writhing Storm is a legendary snake leviathan from the plane of Ikoria.

Yidaro is a huge and deadly Dinosaur Turtle from Ikoria. He is capable of incredible damage, but also kind of sweetly inattentive. The monster is easily distracted — his attention tends to wander. But if he ever focuses his attention on something, he will obliterate it.
The is a member of the Nine Stars embodying the planet [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars Mars]. He is also in charge of the Department of Fire.
Balant Mornlight was a halfling fighter adventurer of infamous ill luck, active in the 14 century DR.
.]] The Tiger Spirit is a mystical deity worshipped by Jago and the clan of monks he belongs to.

Aladdin was a rogue from Rabiah, famous for his lamp and his ring, and his artifact-thieving skills. Aladdin's destructive ring was gifted by a magician, who told him it was a formidable talisman against evil, as long as Aladdin kept obeying the magician. Aladdin's lamp, a relic of legend, allowed its bearer to shape destiny, turning uncertainty into opportunity, much like the fabled wishes of old.

Asha "the Blessed" is a mythical figure from Alara, an archangel who was said to have battled Malfegor before the Sundering. She ultimately sacrificed herself to banish the demon, but contrary to the written record she was unable to slay him.
Barkess Lanys was one of the founding members of the Knights of the Sword Coast during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Banath'thur is a criminal demon from Alara. He has been known as the Demon of Qasal, the Defiler of Souls, and Hell's Lash. He has been wanted for mass destruction and soul corruption throughout Jund, Naya, and Bant. In addition to conspiracy to commit genocide, entering a contract with a minor, forgery, torture, and two counts of destruction of a holy being.
Brinelin is the Zendikar Moon Kraken that ruled the waters of the bays of Akoum.

Brisela was created from the broken bodies and minds of Bruna and Gisela. Once two of the most powerful angels on Innistrad, they were conscripted by Emrakul and are now melded together to serve as the Eldrazi titan's messenger. Brisela was slain by Thalia under the influence of Saint Traft and Sigarda in Thraben.
Baldur's Delight was a type of dessert treat from the city of Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast, a fabled creation of Mother Baldur.
Bori Andon is a well-respected Nivix guildmage and Izzet blastseeker on Ravnica, highly skilled but incredibly reckless. He was at one point on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.
Eight-and-a-Half-Tails (), born Wise-Muzzle, was the highest spiritual leader of the kitsune on the plane of Kamigawa.

Elesh Norn (Phyrexian: Ducg,norn, IPA: [ʔelʃ norn]) was the Praetor of the white-aligned Machine Orthodoxy, which led New Phyrexia. She was called The Mother of Machines, Grand Praetor, or Grand Cenobite by her followers. As the ruler of New Phyrexia, she oversaw the New Phyrexian Invasion of the Multiverse, achieving full or partial conquests of numerous worlds. However, despite early successes, she was thwarted in the final battle by a combined coalition of Planeswalkers, Mirran rebels, and the war hosts of Zhalfir. She was subsequently killed by Karn.
Barkskin Armor was a suit of enchanted hide armor imbued with protective forest aegis magic.
Dragonhawk, also called the Storm Hawk, is an anomaly on the plane of Bloomburrow - a being that behaves much like a Calamity Beast, but is neither truly from the plane nor an elemental creature.
Drufalden was the last of the Rigida, an ice queen ruling over a cold realm in the Borderlands in 3050 AR.
Kaldra was a gigantic Mirran avatar composed of blue-white plasma that was summoned by Glissa Sunseeker after she collected the three so-called Kaldra artifacts (a helmet, a shield and a sword).
Bane of the Depths was the inscription on a sword belonging to the dhaeraowathila Nairen in the mid-14 century DR. It may have been magical.
Kalamax, the Stormsire, is a legendary elemental dinosaur from the plane of Ikoria.

Mat'Selesnya is the parun of the Selesnya Conclave and the worldsoul of Ravnica. As the guild's parun, Mat'Selesnya participated in the Signing of the Guildpact. An elemental formed from the union of several dryads, Mat'selesnya was encased within Vitu-Ghazi for several thousand years, until Szadek tried to destroy her during the decamillennial. She is described as a being with bark-like skin, with large crystals inserted into her arms and legs and encasing her dryad-like head. She currently still lives deep inside Vitu-Ghazi, and speaks through Trostani. Encompassing all things on the plane both alive and dead, she can even manifest the ghosts of severed branches of Vitu-Ghazi.
Meloku (MEHL-oh-koo; ) was a soratami ambassador to the human world at daimyo Konda's court in Eiganjo, and especially to the human students of the arcane at the Minamo School on Kamigawa.
Bastard swords were a type of sword that fell in-between longswords and greatswords.

Talibah of Emberwilde is an embermage from Dominaria. She was a member of the Mages of the Emberwilde Order, a group of Suq'Ata mages who pledged their allegiance to the djinn and efreet of Wildfire. Talibah is a thug with power. However, her tone becomes very enlightened and "less aggressive" when referring to Wildfire. Wildfire was instrumental in defending Suq’Ata against Kaervek during the Mirage Wars when it commanded its sorcerers, djinn, efreets, and spirits against the dark legions. Indeed, as the Suq’Ata shrank into their empire, it was the power of the Emberwilde that helped maintain their closed border.
Tayam is a legendary nightmare beast from the plane of Ikoria.
Teneb (TEHN-ehb), the Harvester, is a male primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

The Battle of Deepfires was a battle fought beneath Mount Grimmerfang between the shield dwarves of Roldilar and the orcs of the Vast in north Faerûn in the Year of the Bloody Crown, 649 DR. It marked the fall of the kingdom of the Roldilar.
Thryx is a legendary elemental giant on Theros, a being of sea and storms.
Verdeloth was a legendary magnigoth treefolk from Yavimaya who fought in the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria around AR 4205.

Zirda, the Dawnwaker is a legendary elemental fox from the plane of Ikoria. Legends says that the sun resides in Raugrin. The planeswalker Vivien Reid expected to find a monster of intense power and heat; instead, she found Zirda, a creature of immeasurable beauty. Vivien approached it and Zirda permitted her to briefly stroke its fur, which felt like the warmth of a perfect sunbeam. Zirda fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.

The Bedine were a proud, warlike race that inhabited the southern Anauroch regions but were concentrated in the region known as the Sword. Most folk of the Realms had no idea that the Bedine even existed, and those who did rarely could understand the difficult conditions of survival that drove them to live the way that they did.

Carl "Crusher" Creel, a.k.a. Absorbing Man, is a Marvel Comics villain who appears in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.. He has the power to turn into any material he touches. Absorbing Man was created by Stan Lee and Bill Everett.
The Al Muddy Sultan is an evil giant subterranean carnivorous mud-monster from the Aladdin TV series and ruler of the Al Muddy race.
Anton is a minor character on Once Upon a Time. He was once the most fearsome giant of them all.

Barundar mac Idrin was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn, in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord of Earthfast in the 8th century DR.

Asha is the protagonist of Disney's 2023 animated feature film Wish. She is a witty and optimistic 17-year-old girl from the kingdom of Rosas, who sees a darkness in her kingdom that no one else can see and whose impassioned plea brings down an actual Star.

Atog is one of the Kinkow giants. He is used as the final exam at Fight School. He is shown in the episode, "Fight School". Boomer and Brady lost to him in a fight. They later participated in a rematch and defeated him.
Attuma is a supervillain from Marvel Comics, and an Atlantean nomadic warlord. Attuma was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

The Battle of the Haunted Plains was a battle fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk. It took place in the Haunted Plains in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR.

Carnage is a vicious, powerful symbiote created through enhancing samples of the original Venom symbiote, originating from Marvel Comics. Ultimate Spider-Man introduced two versions of Carnage, the first version being a symbiote-infected Peter Parker mixed with his spider-powers, created by the Green Goblin. The second was created by Michael Morbius as a completely separate creature. The second Carnage is far more evolved and powerful, being capable of taking a humanoid form without a host, and being intelligent enough to speak. Carnage was created by David Michelinie and Erik Larsen.

Dar-Benn is a fictional supervillain from Marvel Comics. She made her Marvel Cinematic Universe debut in the 2023 film The Marvels, where she serves as the main antagonist. She is portrayed by Zawe Ashton. A warrior and scientist, Dar-Benn is a politician hellbent on saving the Krees’ home planet of Hala and exalting her people to their rightful place in the universe. Strengthened by a Cosmi-Rod and a mystical bangle, Dar-Benn will stop at nothing to seek revenge on Carol. Dar-Benn was created by writer Ron Marz and artist Ron Lim.

Digger, also known as Experiment 529, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to dig or drill holes through planets, making him capable of digging or drilling through many other surfaces.
Belamy Lightfingers was a halfling fighter from a Strongheart clan in Red Larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn in the late 15 century DR.

Electro (real name Maxwell "Max" Dillon) is a supervillain originating from Marvel Comics Earth-120703, and an enemy of Spider-Man. He appears as the secondary antagonist in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Spider-Man: No Way Home, played by Jamie Foxx, reprising his role from The Amazing Spider-Man 2. Electro was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.
The Electric Storm Eel is a minor character featured in the Disney Jr. series Jake and the Never Land Pirates. The Electric Storm Eel has the power to create storms and waves.

Evil Buzz Lightyear is a recurring antagonist in the Disney/Pixar animated series Buzz Lightyear of Star Command. He comes from an alternate universe, where he, instead of Zurg, is the Evil Emperor, and has complete control over the galaxy.
Bautha z'hin, meaning "dodge and walk", was a fighting style taught among drow. It made use of their natural agility and their favored light armor.
Gilgamesh is a Marvel Comics character, who appears in Eternals, played by Don Lee. Gilgamesh was created by Jack Kirby.
The Goliathon is a major antagonist in the 2014 Disney•Pixar animated special Toy Story That Time Forgot. He is an enormous Erythosuchus that is part of the fictional Battlesaurs toy line.

Haku is the deuteragonist of Spirited Away. Though appearing to be a young boy, Haku is actually a river spirit - Nigihayami Kohakunushi (translated as "God of the Swift Amber River"; or "Spirit of the Kohaku River" in the English dub).
Bathed-In-Blood was a magical suit of plate mail armor commissioned by Kheros the Red, a priest of Tempus.
Hay Lin is the Guardian of Air, from the TV show W.I.T.C.H. She along with the other Guardians help to save Earth as well as other planets from evil, all while managing a normal life.

Havok (real name Alexander Summers) is a Marvel Comics character who appears in both and X-Men '97. He is Cyclops' long-lost brother and a member of the X-Factor. Havok was created by Arnold Drake and Don Heck.
Hego is a minor character from the animated series Kim Possible. Hego is the older brother of Shego and the oldest sibling of Team Go.
Beirmoura was a legendary sword of Thentia. Known also as the "Bright Sword" of Thentia, it was forged to slay wizards.

Helen Rachel Slater is an American actress and singer-songwriter. She is probably best known for playing the title character role in the 1984 adaptation of Supergirl. She also is well-known for her role as Bonnie Rayburn in the 1991 comedy City Slickers. For Disney, she played Sandy Kessler in the 1986 Touchstone Pictures film Ruthless People and Katherine's Mom in Toothless. She also played Kristin Mercer in the ABC Family sitcom The Lying Game.
Hephaestus is a supporting character in the Disney+ series Percy Jackson and the Olympians. He is the God of Fire and Forging who creates a series of advanced machinery to challenge Percy Jackson.
Jadis the White Witch is the main antagonist who appears in the 2005 Disney/Walden Media adaptation of The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe.

Bearberries were a type of edible berry in the Sword Coast North region that were named after the fact that they were most commonly eaten by bears. They were believed to possess some curative properties.

Lashana Lynch is an English actress. She is best known for playing the role of Rosaline Capulet in the ABC period drama series Still Star-Crossed (2017) and MI6 agent Nomi in (2021). For Disney, she portrayed Maria Rambeau in the 2019 Marvel Cinematic Universe film Captain Marvel, which she reprised in the 2023 film The Marvels, as well as playing the character Binary in The Marvels and in the 2026 film Avengers: Doomsday, and Captain Marvel in the 2022 film Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

Queen Moon Butterfly is a major character in the Disney XD animated series Star vs. the Forces of Evil. She is the former Queen of the Mewni alongside her husband, River Butterfly, and Star Butterfly's mother. She was the previous wielder of the Royal Magic Wand before passing it down to her daughter on her fourteenth birthday.
Mother Nature is the ruler of all nature, and a member of the Council of Legendary Figures in The Santa Clause 2 and The Santa Clause 3: The Escape Clause.
Bazoril Gimlode was a dwarven merchant that operated on the Sword Coast North during the late 15 century DR.

Pinhead, also known as the Hell Priest, is the main antagonist of the 2022 reboot horror film Hellraiser. She is the leader of a group of savage entities known as Cenobites who worship the eldritch deity Leviathan in an interdimensional hell known as the Labyrinth. She along with the rest of the Cenobites take sadistic pleasure in kidnapping and torturing anybody unfortunate enough to find one of the Configuration Boxes.

Planetoid Q is a living planetesimal with a jack o' lantern-esque face, in Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go!, ordered by the Skeleton King to collide with Shuggazoom. Later, it is convinced by Chiro to make its own decisions and do what it wants, instead of listening to the Skeleton King's commands. Planetoid Q appeared as an aspect of the Dreamlands in a later episode.
Polyphemus is a minor antagonist in the Disney+ series Percy Jackson and the Olympians. He is a giant cyclops who possesses the Golden Fleece and kidnapped Grover Underwood.
The battle axe of Mauletar was an enchanted axe once wielded by the guardsman named Mauletar during the Thayan civil war of 1074 DR.

Rogue (real name Anna Marie Darkhölme) is one of the main characters who appears in both and X-Men '97. She is a mutant with the ability to absorb the life force, attributes, memories, and superpowers of anyone through physical touch. Rogue was created by Chris Claremont and Michael Golden.

Squirrel Girl (real name Doreen Green) is a Marvel Comics character, who is shown as a comedic character. She is one of the main characters in the Marvel Rising series. Squirrel Girl was created by Steve Ditko and Will Murray.

Sylvie, born Loki Laufeydottir and also known as The Variant, is a character from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the deuteragonist of the Disney+ series Loki. She is the Goddess of Mischief, a Variant of Loki who has been hunted by the Time Variance Authority most of her life and plots to destroy the organization. The TVA recruits another Loki Variant to help them capture her, however, the two of them become reluctant allies instead. As they help each other survive and face imminent death on Lamentis, they unexpectedly fall in love, creating a branched timeline and forming a bond that could potentially destroy the current known reality. At the same time, Sylvie and Loki help to uncover the truth behind the TVA. Eventually, she has her revenge by murdering He Who Remains, the one behind the TVA, which frees the Sacred Timeline but also unleashes his Variants in the Multiverse, risking the start of another Multiversal War. This version of the mythological Loki was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, Larry Lieber, Don Rico, Christopher Rule, Violet Barclay, Chu Hing, Mike Sekowsky, Pierce Rice, and Syd Shores. Sylvie the Enchantress was created by Paul Cornell and Mark Brooks.
Beholder armor was an odd kind of magical device used by beholders to walk around.

Tegan Kimball is a character in the supernatural teen drama series Coven Academy. Tegan is a time-bending witch attending Crescent Veil Academy, where she forms part of the central coven alongside her friends, Briar and Sasha.

The Curse Dragon is an antagonist in the 2020 Disney/Pixar animated feature film Onward. It is an artificial dragon made out of debris of Ian's high school, and was summoned by the theft of the cursed Phoenix Gem from a fountain across the street by Barley Lightfoot.

The Core also known as the Night from the ancient Olm prophecy was a biomechanical creature and the overarching antagonist of the 2019 Disney Channel animated series Amphibia. It is an amalgam of Amphibia's greatest minds and the true master of King Andrias. While possessing the body of Marcy Wu, it referred to itself as Darcy.
Bastard's Inheritance was a unique enchanted short sword wielded by the dwarvish rogue Larethar Gulgrin in the late 15 century DR.
Thundra is a recurring character from Aladdin: The Series. She is a rain bird who controls the world's weather and Iago's love interest.

The Titans are supporting antagonists in the 1997 Disney animated feature film, Hercules. They are portrayed as four gargantuan elemental monsters who terrorized Ancient Greece. They were each the physical manifestation of the element they controlled. Though based on Greek mythology, these "Titans" were original creations for the film. Hercules: The Series featured Titan characters from actual Greek mythology.
Tom Lucitor is the demon prince of the Underworld and Star Butterfly's ex-boyfriend in the Disney XD animated series Star vs. the Forces of Evil.
Bastion was a magical tower shield kept at the Old Man's Face in the mid-1480s DR.

Yondu Udonta is a Marvel Comics character who appears in the Marvel Studios film Guardians of the Galaxy and its sequel. Yondu is an interstellar bandit and a leader within the Ravagers. He becomes Peter Quill's guardian after abducting him from Earth. Yondu was created by Arnold Drake and Gene Colan and is played by Michael Rooker.

Stompillar (originally called Corkpedite) is a golem enemy in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars, found in Barrel Volcano. Stompillars are immensely powerful creatures in battle, mostly due to their great physical attacks and defense. It is divided into two parts: a head (called the "Stompillar" itself in the game) and a body (named the "Body"). Both parts have separate health points, so Mario must defeat both parts to completely defeat the creature. The two parts share resistances and weakness, but the head has superior stats, because it is the one that actually attacks. Once the head is eliminated, the Body will use Migraine on one of Mario's party members. If the Body is defeated first, the head will defeat itself on its next turn. Lava Babbles and Urspikes are often fought alongside the creature in battle. Stompillars can also be encountered outside of battle, unlike many large enemies in the game, though they are gray, their pieces are somewhat more compacted together, and they lack a Body. They can be seen knocking Urspikes from the ceiling by stomping the ground. There is an unused enemy named Pile Driver who shares the same sprite as the Stompillar, only shaded blue.
